# WattLog

> WattLog is a Sustainable Campus Initiative dashboard that helps universities track real-time energy consumption and carbon emissions across campus devices.

WattLog lets campus members log device usage (wattage × duration), then computes kilowatt-hours and CO₂ emissions using verified Philippine grid factors (DOE / IGES). The platform surfaces analytics, predictive scenarios, and exportable reports to support evidence-based sustainability decisions.
